title: Upper ME: Press
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Lateral Lunge × 6/side · Eccentric Push-Up with Extension × 5 · Bird Dog × 6/side
jumps: DB Bench Press 3 @ RPE 8, fast up → Plyometric Push-Up 5 → Med Ball Chest Pass 5 → Medicine Ball Slams 5
Concentric wk 1: normal lowering, then drive up as FAST as possible · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds
note: Concentric phase: no tempo. Control the way down, then move the bar as fast as you can.
